status.COMPLETE: Traced end to end in the current source and covered by a test or a live proof. Not 'a page exists'.
status.FINISH: Real implementation exists but a named part of it is missing. The missing part is in next_action.
status.CONSOLIDATE: Two or more implementations answer the same question and can drift apart.
status.REMOVE: Code with no caller. Delete it or give it a caller - a decision, not a cleanup.
status.POLICY_REQUIRED: The code is correct and deliberately refuses to act until a human decides. Nobody has decided.
status.BLOCKED: Cannot proceed without something outside this repository.
status.NOT_BUILT: No implementation found. Searched, not assumed.

how_to_read.priority: P0 stop-the-world, P1 next, P2 soon, P3 whenever
how_to_read.completed_on: null unless a commit or a dated document proves it. Never guessed.
how_to_read.previously_missed: true = this was NOT on any earlier roadmap and is being added now, openly.

items.title: Two proposal systems exist side by side
items.evidence: proposal_router (20 routes, require_admin, tenant-side, frontend ProposalEditor.jsx at /proposals) and sales_proposal_router (22 routes, require_sales_member, brand-sales side, ProposalPanel.jsx). Both implement blocks, publish, send, tokens, file upload and analytics.
items.notes: These serve different audiences - an advisor proposing to a family, and a rep proposing the platform to a business - so this is not obviously wrong. But 42 routes implement the same document model twice, and only one of them has any test coverage.
items.decision_required: Are these genuinely two products, or one document engine with two audiences?
items.next_action: Answer the question before either grows again. If they stay separate, say so in a comment in both files.
